This game was so fun at launch. The characters were cool and sexy, abilities were fun and distinct, and the missions were fun to do. 
Power creep multiplied fast and now every character does the same, which is they all do everything. 
Sexy is fun, but they went overboard with it and now characters are barely wearing anything, which is not as sexy as they might think it is. 
The game became a mindless farm of the same missions over and over and over and it got boring. 

I hope they balance descendants around their unique playstyles and make them be meaningful to have on your team. New missions and better drop rates would be good too. I ain't playing the same mission 300 times to farm a weapon, which I then have to wait for hours (days for ult descendants) to "cook". 

Sexy skins are fun, but damn give your game something cool too. Everyone running around in lingerie with their tits out is embarrassing for such a cool game concept.

I remember thinking it was so useful to have Yujin, Luna or Ajax on the team to fight colossi, where now you just get in, wait for a random Serena (or whoever really)  to one shot the boss, rinse and repeat.
Give it a shot. It's FREE, you got nothing to lose.
